definition: Software infrastructure used to systematically run a model against a suite of benchmarks or test cases and collect standardized performance metrics.
details: Evaluation harnesses (such as EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness) provide reproducible, standardized ways to compare models across many benchmarks, reducing inconsistencies that can arise from ad hoc, custom evaluation scripts.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. In plain words: Software infrastructure used to systematically run a model against a suite of benchmarks or test cases and collect standardized performance metrics. Here is how it actually plays out: Evaluation harnesses (such as EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness) provide reproducible, standardized ways to compare models across many benchmarks, reducing inconsistencies that can arise from ad hoc, custom evaluation scripts. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Model Evaluation Harness.
